# Bid the opening, the lights, and the rot.

> Price an entry-door replacement from sidelights, transom, out-of-square openings, jamb rot, brickmold, storm door, and paint — not a published $1,200-installed steel special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
